Overview

This feature service provides the fire protection area boundary for the district of Peachland and supports local fire service planning and operational use. It contains a single polygon layer representing the area served by the fire protection district.

Feature Layers

  • PCH Fire Protection Area: A polygon layer that defines the fire protection area for Peachland. The layer includes a descriptive area name and standard geodatabase tracking fields for feature creation and editing.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers the district of Peachland within the Regional District of Central Okanagan in British Columbia.

Use Cases

  • Fire service administration and boundary reference
  • Emergency response planning and jurisdiction lookup
  • Local government mapping and public information
